```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library("pacman")
pacman::p_load(stringr, tidyverse, gtsummary, ggplot2, GGally, vtable, grid, gridExtra)
source("replace_chunk.R")
peter_file <- "C:/Users/samake/OneDrive - Oregon Health & Science University/AD and DS Project/csand_data.duckdb/csand_data.duckdb"
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(peter_file))

```


```{r}
### set up assessments
tbl_diag <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select(contains("fluency"), visit_id) %>% 
  collect
### set up demographics
tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id, csa_id, race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
### get name of assessments
diag_name<- data.frame(colnames(tbl_diag))
```
### clean up fluency
```{r}
fluency_tbl <- tbl_diag%>% 
  select(visit_id, which_tests_in_baseline_2_Category_fluency_animals, contains('catfluency'))%>%
  collect
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(fluency_tbl))
#chosing catfluencydate, catfluency60, catfluencydate_status,  catfluency30 
```


```{r}
fluency_cleaned <- fluency_tbl %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>% 
  select(-c(contains('catfluencyg'), contains('shape'))) %>% 
  drop_na()
  
#65 patients now   
  
```

###clean up demographics
```{r}
# set up/ data cleaning from exp_diag
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age))
```

###Figure 1 setup (changeable)
```{r}
tab_1 <- demographics %>% 
  select(-c(ptid, visit_id, visit_type, visit_date, csa_id, new_id, shape, shape_num)) %>%
  mutate(
   age_group = case_when(
      as.integer(age) >= 0  & as.integer(age) <= 17 ~ "0-17",
      as.integer(age) >= 18 & as.integer(age) <= 34 ~ "18-34",
      as.integer(age) >= 35 & as.integer(age) <= 49 ~ "35-49",
      as.integer(age) >= 50 & as.integer(age) <= 64 ~ "50-64",
      as.integer(age) >= 65 & as.integer(age) <= 79 ~ "65-79",
      as.integer(age) >= 80 & as.integer(age) <= 94 ~ "80-94",
      as.integer(age) >= 95  ~ "95+",
      .default =  NA
  ))
```

```{r}
further_tab1 <- tab_1 %>% 
select(-c(age, diagnosis, num_diagnosis)) 
```

```{r}
# table 1 for paper #race 
table_1 <- tbl_summary(
  further_tab1,
  by = further_diag,
  type = all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical",
  statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
  label = c(list(race = "Race"), 
            list(eth = "Ethnicity"), 
            list(age_group = "Age"), 
            list(gender = "Gender"), 
            list(medicaid = "Medicaid")),
  missing_text = "Missing Values") %>% 
  as_gt()

gt::gtsave(table_1, filename = "demo_table.png")
```

### table 2 attempt (inner join stats) 
```{r}
figure_2_data <- test_set %>% 
  select(c(race, eth, age, gender, medicaid, catfluencydate_status, further_diag, new_id.x, visit_id)) %>% 
  mutate(
    healthy_or_not = case_when(
      further_diag == "HC" ~ "HC",
      .default = "cases")
)
```

```{r}
table_2 <- tbl_summary(
  figure_2_data,
  by = healthy_or_not,
  include = c(race, eth, age, gender, medicaid, catfluencydate_status),
  type = all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical",
  statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
  label = c(list(race = "Race"), 
            list(eth = "Ethnicity"), 
            list(age = "Age"), 
            list(gender = "Gender"), 
            list(catfluencydate_status = "Test Status"),
            list(further_diag = "Diagnosis")),
            missing_text = "Missing Values"
) %>% 
  as_gt()
gt::gtsave(table_2, "inner_demo.png" )


# gt save and send  to and  chage gender

```

###Figure 3 how many ids had how many appointments
```{r}
figure_2_data %>% ggplot(aes(x = new_id.x, fill = catfluencydate_status )) +
  geom_bar(stat = "count")+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(healthy_or_not), scales = "free") # add scale free
  
```

### figure 4 plotting every column against each other
```{r}

figure_4_data <-  figure_2_data %>% 
  mutate(
   age_group = case_when(
      as.integer(age) >= 0  & as.integer(age) <= 17 ~ "0-17",
      as.integer(age) >= 18 & as.integer(age) <= 34 ~ "18-34",
      as.integer(age) >= 35 & as.integer(age) <= 49 ~ "35-49",
      as.integer(age) >= 50 & as.integer(age) <= 64 ~ "50-64",
      as.integer(age) >= 65 & as.integer(age) <= 79 ~ "65-79",
      as.integer(age) >= 80 & as.integer(age) <= 94 ~ "80-94",
      as.integer(age) >= 95  ~ "95+",
      .default =  NA
  ))
  
ggpairs(
  figure_4_data %>% select(-new_id.x , -age, -visit_id),
  cardinality_threshold = 22,
  aes(color = healthy_or_not),
  upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor")),
  lower = list(continuous = wrap("points", alpha = 0.3))
)
```
